SocialPilot is a social media management platform for agencies and brands, with scheduling, collaboration, analytics and an AI writing assistant [1]. VEXI makes and posts your social content. They overlap on scheduling, and in many ways they fit together.

SocialPilot describes itself as a social media management platform for agencies and brands, covering publishing, collaboration, engagement, analytics and reviews [1]. Its AI Pilot drafts captions, hashtags and post ideas in a brand voice you set, in ten languages [3][4]. It also has a page for real estate, covering scheduled announcements, shared listings and review requests [5].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on scheduling and do different main jobs. Here is what each one does.

Is SocialPilot built for real estate agents?

SocialPilot serves many industries and has a page for real estate [1][5]. It covers scheduling announcements, sharing partner agents’ listings across accounts, holiday greetings and review requests by email and SMS [5].

SocialPilot publishes its prices [2]. During its Black Friday offer, Essentials shows $21 a month billed annually or $24 billed monthly, Standard $35 or $40, Premium $70 or $80, and Ultimate $140 or $160 [2]. It says there are no contracts and you can cancel anytime [2].
